title: Chat-server: {} no-op + read-only rustdoc drift
description: Mark's decision (on JMAP-t8ej.25 notes): an empty patch {} — literal, or empty after dropping identical server-set values — SUCCEEDS as a no-op: updated {id: null}, no write, state unchanged. RFC 8620 §5.3: server-set properties MAY be in the patch if identical to the current value, else invalidProperties. Chat-server handlers return invalidPatch for an empty patch: space.rs (~1358 'patch contains no valid fields'), contact.rs ~357, ban.rs ~383, emoji.rs ~536; check position.rs and presence.rs. Change to no-op success; existing tests that assert invalidPatch for {} are spec-driven changes, list them in tests_changed. Also fix rustdoc drift left by a22b574a: space.rs ~971/975, position.rs 186-187, contact.rs 196-197, ban.rs 167-168, emoji.rs 314-315, presence.rs 179-180 say read-only keys are always rejected; add 'unless identical to the stored value (RFC 8620 §5.3)'.
